title: AI Mania Is Eviscerating Global Decision-Making
summary: This article critiques the current AI hype cycle, arguing that widespread AI mania is leading to poor decision-making at organizational and global levels. The author examines how the frenzy around AI adoption is causing leaders to make irrational investments and policy decisions without proper evaluation of risks and actual value.
problem_solved: Identifies how irrational AI adoption driven by hype is causing systematic failures in global decision-making processes.
why_valuable: Provides a much-needed critical perspective on the uncritical embrace of AI technology, highlighting the dangers of groupthink and FOMO-driven decisions in both business and policy contexts.
